code_truth.module_doc:
PreToolUse hook: Enforce reading SKILL.md before manual analysis.

This hook prevents Claude from using analysis tools (Read, Grep, Glob, Task)
without first checking the available skills in SKILL.md.

Enforcement strategy:
1. Track whether SKILL.md has been read in this session
2. Block "analysis" tools if SKILL.md hasn't been read yet
3. Provide clear guidance on what to do instead

functions.name: get_state_file
functions.doc: Get state file path for this session.

functions.name: has_read_skills
functions.doc: Check if SKILL.md has been read in this session.

functions.name: mark_skills_read
functions.doc: Mark that SKILL.md has been read in this session.

functions.name: is_reading_skills
functions.doc: Check if this tool call is reading SKILL.md.

functions.name: should_enforce
functions.doc: Determine if we should enforce the skill check.
